title: Gió hoang
about: Round x2 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian), as the user asked for more versions: a wasteland. Wind through a hollow, sounding the chord's root and fifth in gusts, over the dark pad and a deep sub; a low bell far off now and then. B minor at 48 bpm, the C of the Phrygian mode leaning on it. An original piece.
